$comment: Recipe for the Azure architecture icons (prefix `azure`). Generator: scripts/build-icon-pack.mjs. Icon keys and names come from Microsoft's file names; `groups` gives the display names of Microsoft's category folders (an icon filed in several takes the first in this order); `overrides` spells the few names a file name cannot carry. See icons/azure/README.md.

Do not crop, flip or rotate the icons, and do not distort or change their shape.
Use the icons to show how products work together, with the product name close to the icon. Do not use Microsoft product icons to represent your own product or service.
